scores.rationale: Product names are decent but ids like AdKknFxuzMBelZ are not gids and endCursor Y3Vyc2l6ZT1xYWV is odd. priceRange 129.99 conflicts with variants 99.50 and 149.99; handle classic-wool-blanket vs Organic Cotton; query onyx ignored.

gid ids, SKUs like CED-CB-SM and cedar goods are realistic, though ids are sequential and currencies mix USD, CAD, EUR, GBP in one store. Query honored, but INVENTORY_TOTAL order broken (142, 0, 57, 9, 23) and one updatedAt precedes createdAt.

Trailhead Merino socks, Summit flask and Ridgeline shell with sensible prices look real; ids are not gids. Query "cedar" is ignored entirely and INVENTORY_TOTAL with reverse false returns 142, 87, 0. Price ranges match variants.

gid ids, SKUs like LUM-DESK-BLK, per-variant inventory and specific lighting titles read as production. Query lumen honored, totalInventory equals variant sum, price ranges match variants, cursor decodes to last id and value.

Good Lumen lamp, lantern and bulb catalog with coherent vendor; non-gid ids and rounded timestamps are minor tells. Query lumen and PRODUCT_TYPE honored, price ranges match variants; endCursor null despite nodes returned.

Believable products, vendors and price ranges; ids are not gids. Query cedar matches only one product, others are named harbor and quartz after the cursors, and INVENTORY_TOTAL with reverse false comes back 184, 67, 12.

Specific lamp, sconce and lantern entries with varied variants look real; non-gid ids and endCursor "cursor_lumen_outdoor_lighting_2026" are small tells. Query lumen honored, sorted by product type, price ranges match variants.
